title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Ambitious and Unhurried
caption:
The world's ambition runs on comparison, so it never rests. A godly man's ambition runs on calling, so it can wait a season without losing its mind.

Do the work in front of you as well as you can do it. Leave whether it pays off to someone bigger than you. The quiet years build the muscle the visible years will need, nobody claps for them, do them anyway.

Ecclesiastes says there's a time for everything. That includes the waiting.
